## About
Kamboh Associates is a Pakistan-based tax consultancy firm established in 2008, specialising in FBR income tax filing, NTN registration, SECP company formation, sales tax returns, wealth statements, and corporate tax compliance. We serve individuals, salaried persons, freelancers, SMEs, and corporates across Pakistan from our Lahore office.
